tests.title: Administrator logs in and lands on the Dashboard
tests.goal:
Log in to HTX LIMS web

Verify that an administrator can log in with username and password and lands on the Dashboard with the full menu.
preconditions: An administrator account

steps.text: Open the HTX LIMS web home page and click Login
Enter the administrator username and password and click Login

expected.text: The Dashboard opens with the heading HTX - LIMS and the sections Alerts requiring acknowledgement and Latest location
The menu shows Dashboard, Inventory, Registration, Purchase Order, Check In / Out, Stock Take, Gantry, Report, Master Data, System and My Account
The user button at the top shows the user's name and Role: Administrator

notes: ADMIN login -> Dashboard, full menu, Role: Administrator.

tests.title: Login with a wrong password is refused
tests.goal:
Wrong password

Verify that the login page refuses a valid username with a wrong password and does not open the Dashboard.
preconditions: A User account

steps.text: Open the login page
Enter a valid username and the wrong password and click Login

expected.text: The login page stays open with an error message about an invalid login
Opening /dashboard afterwards shows the login page, not the Dashboard

notes: USER2 + wrong password: "Invalid login attempt.", stays on login; /dashboard redirects to login.

tests.title: Log out ends the session
tests.goal:
Log out

Verify that Log Out ends the session so protected pages need a new login.
preconditions: A User account

steps.text: Log in to HTX LIMS web with a User account
Click the user button at the top of the page and click Log Out
Open the Check In page by its address (/checkin)

expected.text: After Log Out the public home page with the Login link is shown
/checkin shows the login page instead of the Check In list

notes: USER1 Log Out -> public home page with Login; /checkin then redirects to the login page.

tests.title: User role sees only the operations menu
tests.goal:
Menu for the User role

Verify that an account with the User role sees only the operations and gantry log pages in the menu.
preconditions: An account with the User role

steps.text: Log in to HTX LIMS web with the User account
Open each menu group

expected.text: The menu shows Dashboard, Inventory (Chemical Usage, Item Information), Registration (Item Register, Asset Tag Printing), Purchase Order (PO Creation, PO Management), Check In / Out (Printed, Tagged Not Checked In, Count Item, Check In, Check Out), Gantry (Gantry Log only) and My Account
Stock Take, Report, Master Data and System are not in the menu
The user button shows Role: User

notes: USER1: Role User; menu Dashboard, Inventory (Chemical Usage, Item Information), Registration, Purchase Order, Check In / Out (5 pages), Gantry (Gantry Log), My Account; no Stock Take, Report, Master Data, System.

tests.title: User role cannot open administrator pages by address
tests.goal:
Admin pages blocked for the User role

Verify that a User-role account typing the address of an administrator page gets the Not Authorized page and no data.
preconditions: An account with the User role

steps.text: Log in to HTX LIMS web with the User account
Open each address in the data list

expected.text: Every address shows "You're Not Authorized! Your account does not have access to this page."
No table, button or record of the page is shown

notes: USER1: all 8 admin addresses show "You're Not Authorized!".

tests.title: Create a purchase order
tests.goal:
PO Creation

Verify that a user can create a purchase order and find it in PO Management.
preconditions: At least one PO location and item type exist in the PO Creation lists
data: PO Number and PO Name: QA-PO-<unique>
PO Date: today, Delivery Date: today + 7 days

steps.text: Log in to HTX LIMS web with a User account
Open Purchase Order > PO Creation
Fill PO Number, PO Name, Address, Supplier, Department, Team In Charge, Contact Person, Contact Number
Pick a PO Location and an Item Type, set PO Date and Delivery Date
Click Submit
Open Purchase Order > PO Management and search for the PO Number

expected.text: A success message is shown after Submit
PO Management lists the PO with its PO Number, PO Name and status
The Manager column shows the user who created it

notes: USER1 created QA-PO-3781642 (HTX Store Room, Box, PO date 18/11, delivery 25/11): "Successfully creating a new PO."; PO Management lists it, Manager User1, status APPROVED straight away (no approval step). Deleted afterwards.

tests.title: PO Creation requires a PO date
tests.goal:
PO date required

Verify that PO Creation does not submit without a PO date.

steps.text: Log in to HTX LIMS web with a User account
Open Purchase Order > PO Creation
Fill the PO Number and PO Name, leave PO Date empty and click Submit

expected.text: The message "PO date is required." is shown under PO Date
No PO with that number appears in PO Management

notes: PO Number + Name filled, no PO Date, Submit: nothing saved (PO Management still 3 POs). Note: "PO date is required." is shown before Submit, and missing PO Location / Item Type get no message.

tests.title: Register a new item
tests.goal:
Item Register

Verify that a user can register a new item and it appears in the list of registered items not checked in yet.
preconditions: Item categories and item types exist (Master Data)
data: Item category: Consumable (e.g.), first item type of that category

steps.text: Log in to HTX LIMS web with a User account
Open Registration > Item Register
Pick the item category and item type, fill Item description, Number of units and Serial number
Click Register

expected.text: A success message is shown and the form is cleared
Registered items not checked in yet lists the item with a new Item Number, the description, category, item type and serial
Its Status is NOT PRE CHECK IN and Tag printed is empty

notes: Registered Chemical/Toluene "QA chem 122612": message "1 item(s) registered with Item Number 003000025"; listed NOT PRE CHECK IN, Tag printed "Not yet"; count 3 -> 4.

tests.title: Register several units at once
tests.goal:
Number of units

Verify that registering an item with Number of units 3 creates three items with the same details and their own item numbers.

steps.text: Log in to HTX LIMS web with a User account
Open Registration > Item Register
Fill the required fields with Number of units 3 and click Register

expected.text: Registered items not checked in yet lists 3 new items with the description
Each has a different Item Number, all with Status NOT PRE CHECK IN

notes: Consumable/Glove "QA multi 152129" x3: "3 item(s) registered with Item Number 002000017 – 002000019"; three rows, NOT PRE CHECK IN; count 3 -> 6. Deleted afterwards.

tests.title: Item Register checks required fields
tests.goal:
Required fields

Verify that Register does not save an item while required fields are empty.

steps.text: Log in to HTX LIMS web with a User account
Open Registration > Item Register
Click Register without filling anything

expected.text: Each required field (marked *) shows a validation message
The count of registered items not checked in yet does not change

notes: Register on an empty form: "Item category is required.", "Item type is required.", "Item description is required."; count stays 3.

tests.title: Check in an item that is out
tests.goal:
Check In

Verify that an item with status OUT can be checked in on the web and becomes IN.
preconditions: At least one item with status OUT in Check In / Out > Check In
data: Item: the first OUT item in the Check In list

steps.text: Log in to HTX LIMS web with a User account
Open Check In / Out > Check In and note the first item's Item Number
Click Check In on its row and confirm

expected.text: A success message is shown and the item leaves the Check In list
Inventory > Item Information shows the item with Status IN at the chosen storage location
If it was on the gantry whitelist (returned loan), it is no longer listed
The item appears in Check In / Out > Check Out under Checked-In Items

notes: ADMIN Check In of 001000029 (OUT, Loan): "Successfully Manual Check-In Selected Item" (no confirmation, no location asked), status IN; but the item stays on the gantry whitelist and keeps purpose LOAN (BUG-001); Loan Out Report Returned with empty Returned On (BUG-004). Repro with 001000027.

tests.title: Check out an item on loan with a due date
tests.goal:
Check Out on loan

Verify that a checked-in item can be checked out on loan with a due date and shows in the Loan Out Report.
preconditions: At least one item with status IN

steps.text: Log in to HTX LIMS web with a User account
Open Check In / Out > Check Out and tick the first item
Set Purpose Loan, Due Date and Remarks, keep the storage location
Click Check Out and confirm

expected.text: A success message is shown and the item leaves Checked-In Items
Item Information shows the item with Status OUT
Report > Loan Out Report lists the item with the due date
Report > Check In Out Report shows a LOAN check-out by the user
Gantry > Gantry Whitelist lists the item, and Report > Stock Level Report shows it under On loan with the item type's Stock unchanged

notes: USER1: 001000029 Loan due 25/11/2026: confirmation then "Checked out 1 item(s) - Loan, loan no 23, due 25/11/2026"; status OUT/LOAN, on Gantry Whitelist, Loan Out Report "On loan", Check In Out Report LOAN row, Box stock unchanged 15 (12 in lab + 3 on loan).

tests.title: Check Out needs a selected item and a due date for loans
tests.goal:
Check Out validation

Verify that Check Out stays disabled with no item selected and that a loan needs a due date.
preconditions: At least one item with status IN

steps.text: Log in to HTX LIMS web with a User account
Open Check In / Out > Check Out
Look at the Check Out button with no item ticked
Tick one item, keep Purpose Loan, leave Due Date empty and click Check Out

expected.text: With no item ticked the button reads Check Out 0 item(s) selected and is disabled
Without a due date a message asks for the Due Date and the item stays IN

notes: Check Out disabled with "0 item(s) selected"; enabled after ticking 001000029; Loan without due date: "A due date is required for a loan.", item stays listed.

tests.title: Stock take progress and results are reported
tests.goal:
Stock take reports

Verify that a completed stock take shows its totals in the Stock Take Progress Report and each item's result in the Stock Take Report.
preconditions: At least one Completed stock take

steps.text: Log in to HTX LIMS web with the administrator account
Open Stock Take > Stock Take List and note a Completed stock take's number and item count
Open Report > Stock Take Progress Report and search for that number
Open Report > Stock Take Report and search for that number

expected.text: The progress report shows status Completed, Total Item equal to the item count, and Commenced/Completed dates and users
The Stock Take Report lists one row per item with Result Located or Not located

notes: ST00000012 (Completed, 2 items): progress report Completed, Total Item 2, Total Scanned 2, commenced/completed by Admin; Stock Take Report 2 rows, both Located. "Total Completed" shows 0 (meaning unclear).

tests.title: Find an item in Item Information
tests.goal:
Item search

Verify that Item Information finds an item by its item number and filters by type and status.
preconditions: At least one item exists
data: Item number: taken from the first row of the list

steps.text: Log in to HTX LIMS web with a User account
Open Inventory > Item Information and note the first item's number, type and status
Search for that item number
Reset, then set Type to the item's type and Status to its status and search

expected.text: The search for the number lists that item
With the filters every listed item has the chosen type and status
Details opens the item's details

notes: Search 001000009 -> Total 1 (that item); Type Chemical + Status IN -> 15 rows, all Chemical/IN; Details opens "Tag details - <number>" with type, batch, status/location, reader.

tests.title: Stock Level Report flags low stock
tests.goal:
Low stock

Verify that the Stock Level Report shows Low for an item type whose stock is at or below its minimum.
preconditions: An item type with a minimum stock set (Master Data > Item Type)

steps.text: Log in to HTX LIMS web with the administrator account
Open Report > Stock Level Report and click Search
Find an item type with Min set

expected.text: Level is Low when Stock is at or below Min, and not Low when it is above
Stock equals In lab + On loan for the row
Export downloads the report with the columns shown

notes: Stock Level: Alcohol 70 (2, min 10) and Alcohol 90 (1, min 15) Low; Box/Chemicals/Consumables/Fixed Asset Stock = In lab + On loan; Export > MS-Excel downloads "Stock Level Report 18112026.xlsx".

tests.title: Stock Expiry Report lists items expiring within a number of days
tests.goal:
Expiring stock

Verify that the Stock Expiry Report lists only items expiring within the chosen number of days.
preconditions: At least one item with an expiry date in the next 30 days

steps.text: Log in to HTX LIMS web with the administrator account
Open Report > Stock Expiry Report, set Expiring within (days) to 30 and click Search

expected.text: Every row has Days left of 30 or fewer (expired items show their status)
Days left matches the expiry date counted from today

notes: Expiring within 30 days: 5 rows (Formaldehyde -18 Expired, Sodium Hydroxide 0, Hexamine1 3, Isopropanol 11, item001 12); Days left matches the expiry date from today.

tests.title: Audit Trail records user actions
tests.goal:
Audit Trail

Verify that the Audit Trail records a login and a change with user, workstation IP, action, target and time.

steps.text: Log in to HTX LIMS web with the administrator account
Open Report > Audit Trail and filter User by the administrator's username

expected.text: The latest entries include this login with the current time
Each row shows Time, User, Workstation IP, Action, Target and Details

notes: Audit Trail logs logins (web/handheld), failed login, item registered/number assigned/deleted, check-out (no workstation IP), stock adjustment; the two web Manual Check-Ins of 18/11 11:43 and 11:46 (001000029, 001000027) are missing.

tests.title: Add an item type to a category
tests.goal:
Item Type

Verify that an administrator can add an item type with min and max stock and pick it in Item Register.

steps.text: Log in to HTX LIMS web with the administrator account
Open Master Data > Item Type and click Add Item Type
Enter the data and save
Open Registration > Item Register and pick category Consumable

expected.text: Item Type lists the new type with its category, min and max
The Item type list in Item Register offers the new type for Consumable

notes: Added "QA type 126550" (Consumable, max 10; min left empty because the default min 1 would raise a Low stock alert for a type with 0 items); listed in Item Type and offered in Item Register as "(min - / max 10)"; deleted afterwards.

tests.title: The gantry whitelist follows the check-out purpose
tests.goal:
Whitelist by purpose

Verify that checking out on Loan or No return puts the item on the gantry whitelist, For use does not, and checking the item in again takes it off.
preconditions: Three items with status IN
data: Purposes: Loan (due date tomorrow), No return, For use

steps.text: Log in to HTX LIMS web with the administrator account
Check out the first item on Loan, the second on No return and the third For use
Open Gantry > Gantry Whitelist (and, if available, Swagger GET /api/Gantry: the list the gantries download)
Check the Loan item in again through the return flow (pre check-in, count, check in)
Open Gantry > Gantry Whitelist again

expected.text: After step 2 the Loan and No return items are on the whitelist and the For use item is not
After step 4 the returned Loan item is no longer on the whitelist

notes: Loan check-out added 001000029 to the whitelist (pass); check-in did not remove it (BUG-001). No return / For use part not run.

tests.title: A new item gets a 9-digit item number from its category
tests.goal:
Item number format

Verify that a newly registered item gets a 9-digit Item Number made of the category ID (3 digits) and a running number (6 digits).
data: Item category: Chemical (category ID 003), item description: QA item <unique>, CAS number: 64-17-5

steps.text: Log in to HTX LIMS web with a User account
Open Registration > Item Register and note the highest Item Number of a Chemical item in Inventory > Item Information
Register one Chemical item

expected.text: The new Item Number has 9 digits and starts with 003
Its last 6 digits are the next running number after the highest existing Chemical item

notes: New Chemical item number 003000025: 9 digits, prefix 003, next after 003000024.

tests.title: A chemical cannot be registered without a CAS number
tests.goal:
CAS number required

Verify that Item Register refuses a Chemical item without a CAS number.

steps.text: Log in to HTX LIMS web with a User account
Open Registration > Item Register, pick category Chemical, fill item type and description, leave CAS number empty
Click Register

expected.text: A message says the CAS number is required
No item is added to Registered items not checked in yet

notes: Chemical with all other required fields, no CAS: "CAS number is required for chemicals."; nothing saved.

tests.title: A registered item can be deleted only until its tag is printed
tests.goal:
Delete before printing

Verify that a registered item can be deleted while its tag has not been printed, and cannot be deleted after printing.
preconditions: A registered item without a printed tag
A registered item with a printed tag

steps.text: Log in to HTX LIMS web with a User account
Open Registration > Item Register
Delete the item without a printed tag
Try to delete the item with a printed tag

expected.text: The unprinted item is deleted and leaves the list
The printed item offers no delete, or the delete is refused with a message

notes: Delete on the unprinted QA item 003000025 removed it (count 4 -> 3); printed items (001000030, 002000016, 003000024) show only Edit. Delete has no confirmation.

tests.title: Checking out an expired chemical is refused
tests.goal:
FEFO: expired

Verify that Check Out refuses a chemical or consumable that is past its expiry date and saves nothing.
preconditions: A chemical with status IN that is past its expiry date

steps.text: Log in to HTX LIMS web with a User account
Open Check In / Out > Check Out, tick the expired chemical, set Purpose For use and click Check Out

expected.text: A message says the item is expired and cannot be checked out
The item stays IN

notes: Formaldehyde 37% 003000012 (expired 31/10/2026), Loan: "These items are expired and cannot be checked out: - 003000012 (Formaldehyde 37%, batch FA-2410, expiry 31/10/2026)"; stays IN. Run with purpose Loan instead of For use so it could be undone.

tests.title: If one item of a check-out fails, nothing is saved
tests.goal:
All or nothing

Verify that a check-out of several items where one item is refused saves none of them.
preconditions: One valid IN item and one expired chemical with status IN

steps.text: Log in to HTX LIMS web with a User account
Open Check Out, tick both items and click Check Out

expected.text: The check-out is refused with the reason for the expired item
Both items stay IN

notes: Methanol HPLC Grade 003000008 + expired Formaldehyde 003000012, Loan: refused with the expired message before the confirmation; Methanol stays IN (still in Checked-In Items).

tests.title: A loan due date in the past is refused
tests.goal:
Loan due date

Verify that a Loan check-out with a due date in the past is refused.
preconditions: An item with status IN

steps.text: Log in to HTX LIMS web with a User account
Open Check Out, tick the item, set Purpose Loan and Due Date yesterday, click Check Out

expected.text: The past date cannot be picked, or a message says the due date cannot be in the past
The item stays IN

notes: Loan Due Date picker: past days (e.g. 17/11) are disabled and cannot be picked.

tests.title: Expiring and expired items raise Dashboard alerts
tests.goal:
Expiry alerts

Verify that an IN item expiring within 30 days raises an Expiring alert and an IN item past its expiry date raises an Expired alert.
preconditions: An IN item expiring within 30 days and one past its expiry date (or register one with such an expiry date and check it in)

steps.text: Log in to HTX LIMS web with the administrator account
Open the Dashboard and Report > Stock Expiry Report

expected.text: Each IN item expiring within 30 days has an Expiring alert with the expiry date and days left
Each IN item past its expiry has an Expired alert
Items that are OUT raise no expiry alert

notes: Expiring alert for Hexamine1 (21/11) and item001 (30/11) on the Dashboard; Sodium Hydroxide / Isopropanol had Expiring alerts on 09/11 acknowledged by ADMIN 17/11; Formaldehyde has Expired. Older alerts show old item numbers (IFD-1-0000xx), see Q-005.

tests.title: Stock at or below minimum raises a Low stock alert
tests.goal:
Low and high stock

Verify that an item type whose stock is at or below its Min raises a Low stock alert, and at or above its Max a High stock alert.
preconditions: An item type with Min and Max set in Master Data > Item Type

steps.text: Log in to HTX LIMS web with the administrator account
Compare Report > Stock Level Report with the Dashboard alerts

expected.text: Every item type with Stock <= Min has a Low stock alert: "Stock for <type> is <n> item(s), at or below minimum <min>."
Every item type with Stock >= Max has a High stock alert

notes: Stock Level: Alcohol 70 2 <= min 10 and Alcohol 90 1 <= min 15 show Low; Dashboard has the matching Low stock alerts. No item type has a Max, so High stock was not checked.
